notes: The official class profile page, read on September 27, 2026, is headed Class Profile of 2028 and covers the Full-Time +Flex MBA; it replaced the Class of 2027 profile (106 students, average GMAT 607, GPA 3.48) the library carried until then, which the source check had reported as a page probably built by JavaScript (INC-0158). GMAT 618 is labeled current edition, previously called GMAT Focus, and no classic-scale GMAT is published; the page no longer gives a total GRE. Acceptance rate is not published on the class profile or admissions pages. The employment report PDF now on kelley.iu.edu is the 2025-26 edition covering the graduating Class of 2025, replacing the prior Class of 2024 data; the old newdev.kelley.iu.edu host no longer resolves. Tuition confirmed on the official Kelley tuition page at the 2026-27 rate, replacing the Clear Admit sourced entry.
